findings.title: Array diff allocates a full n×m LCS table with deep comparisons
findings.why: After trimming the common prefix and suffix, `diffArrays` allocates (n+1)×(m+1) cells and calls the deep `equal` on each pair. Two large arrays that differ in the middle, such as 10k items each, need about 100M cells and a very long run. The docs don't state a size limit, and the tests only use small arrays.
